## Structure and components

- [statement] Across MEXC, Phemex and BingX, zero-fee futures headlines come with API carve-outs. MEXC's Jun 1, 2026 notice sets an API schedule of 0.06% maker and 0.08% taker, and says API trading is subject to a separate fee structure that takes precedence over promotional offers such as 0-fee events. The Phemex carnival terms exclude API trading, and BingX's TradFi promotion excludes API trading. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-17) — https://www.mexc.com/announcements/article/updates-to-api-futures-trading-fees-jun-1-2026-17827791535742 · keywords: Centralized exchange zero-fee futures programs with API · also: https://phemex.com/blogs/tradfi-futures-zero-fee-carnival, https://bingx.com/en/support/articles/18416986883343/
- [statement] MEXC's API futures fee notices say API trades follow a separate fee structure that takes precedence over web and app rates and over promotional offers such as 0-fee events and MX discounts. MEXC's own example: BTCUSDT futures cost maker 0% and taker 0.01% on the web or app, but trades executed via API are charged the API rate. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-05-28) — https://www.mexc.com/announcements/article/updates-to-api-futures-trading-fees-jun-1-2026-17827791535742 · keywords: Centralized exchange zero-fee futures programs with API · also: https://www.mexc.com/announcements/article/updates-to-api-futures-trading-fees-may-1-2026-17827791535194, https://www.mexc.com/announcements/article/introducing-api-futures-trading-on-mar-31-2026-17827791534551
- [statement] Gate's USDT-M TradFi Perpetuals have a dedicated fee structure effective September 1, 2026. VIP 0 pays 0.0200% maker and 0.0500% taker, and the maker fee is 0.0000% only at VIP 14, VIP 15 and VIP 16, with taker 0.0180%, 0.0150% and 0.0120%. Market-maker tiers pay 0.000% (MM 0) and -0.003%, -0.004% and -0.005% (MM 1 to MM 3). Gate's USDT-M Perpetual Futures Taker Program commences on September 1, 2026, with discounts of 9%, 16% and 20% for monthly taker volume shares of 0.02% ≤ X < 0.2%, 0.2% ≤ X < 1% and X ≥ 1%; participants contact their Account Manager to register. Gate's fee page says users whose API trading volume accounts for at least 60%, or who have reached VIP tier 15 or 16, will be automatically upgraded to advanced institutional users. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-08-26) — https://www.gate.com/announcements/article/101365 · keywords: Centralized exchange zero-fee futures programs with API · also: https://www.gate.com/fee
- [statement] MEXC opened futures trading to the API on Mar 31, 2026, 06:00 (UTC) for users who completed KYC verification, on all futures pairs except Innovation Zone pairs, at 0.01% maker and 0.05% taker. It then raised the API schedule twice: to 0.04% maker and 0.06% taker effective May 1, 2026, at 08:00 (UTC) (notice listed Apr 30, 2026), and to 0.06% maker and 0.08% taker effective Jun 1, 2026, at 08:00 (UTC) (notice listed May 28, 2026). The notices say API trading follows a separate fee structure that takes precedence over web and app rates and promotions such as 0-fee events and MX discounts. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-22) — https://www.mexc.com/announcements/article/introducing-api-futures-trading-on-mar-31-2026-17827791534551 · keywords: Centralized exchange zero-fee futures programs with API · also: https://www.mexc.com/announcements/article/updates-to-api-futures-trading-fees-jun-1-2026-17827791535742, https://www.mexc.com/fr/announcements/api-updates

## How it works

- [statement] AlphaX's zero-fee page navigation lists USDT-settled perpetual contracts, event contracts, demo trading, a trading bot and copy trading, with no API documentation link in the navigation read. The KYCnot directory lists the service as Community, Not tested ("We only checked that it meets our listing rules. Its details and score are as the user declared them."), notes "This service is archived. Its site may be gone or now belong to someone else.", and flags Shotgun KYC ("May request KYC or block funds mid-flow, typically via AML checks, transaction limits, or liquidity partner rules."). Confirm API availability and counterparty standing before relying on AlphaX for automated trading. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-22) — https://www.alphax.com/en/zero-fees · keywords: Centralized exchange zero-fee futures programs with API · also: https://kycnot.me/service/alphax-exchange

## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] Binance's fee page lists a regular user at 0.0200%/0.0500% on USDT-margined contracts, with the USDC/USD1 column showing 0.0000%/0.0400% alongside 0.0200%/0.0500%. The 0.0000% USDT maker rate appears only at VIP 9 (at least 25,000,000,000 USD of trade volume and 5,500 BNB), where the USDT taker rate is 0.0170%. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-22) — https://www.binance.com/en/fee/futureFee
- [statement] Binance's USDS-M Futures Taker Program applies taker fee discounts on top of the BNB fee discount and VIP tier rates. Users who reach a total Binance Futures trading volume of 100,000,000 USDT equivalent in the last 30 days may apply and are assessed in the Program's weekly review. A limited-time promotion effective from 2026-11-10 06:00 (UTC) until 2027-01-03 23:59 (UTC) increases the taker fee discounts for Tier 2 and Tier 3 from 14% to 15% and from 18% to 20%. Users are removed from the Taker Program if they do not meet the minimum criteria for three consecutive weeks, and can reapply after 3 months upon removal. From 2026-11-10 06:00 (UTC) until 2027-01-03 23:59 (UTC), the Tier 2 and Tier 3 taker fee discounts are increased from 14% to 15% and from 18% to 20%, and Tier 1 remains unchanged at 10%. ## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] MEXC's web/app zero-fee futures program grants 0-fee eligibility automatically after regular system evaluations, based on factors such as account status, trading activity, effective trading volume, risk review and market conditions. Certain pairs have a maximum trading volume that is eligible for 0 fees. MEXC's own pages quote different pair counts: an article verified August 19, 2026 says 320+ perpetuals at 0% on both sides, while the 0 Fee Fest FAQ text says 100+ Futures pairs. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-08-19) — https://www.mexc.com/zero-fee · keywords: Centralized exchange zero-fee futures programs with API · also: https://www.mexc.com/learn/article/best-zero-fee-crypto-exchanges-2026-we-checked-8-fee-schedules-only-one-is-zero-on-every-line-/1
- [statement] MEXC's official Futures API provides REST API and WebSocket streaming services. Order placement is POST /api/v1/private/order/create with the required permission Order Placing. Order type 2 is Post Only (maker only), alongside limit, IOC, FOK and market types, and stpMode sets the self-trade prevention mode. Accounts that have not completed KYC can still create an API key but may not be able to enable or use futures order placement–related permissions. API Keys that are not bound to IP addresses are valid for 90 days. Signing uses the HMAC-SHA256 algorithm with a Request-Time header, and a request is invalid if req_time is more than 10 seconds (default) behind or ahead of the server time. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-22) — https://www.mexc.com/api-docs/futures/integration-guide · keywords: Centralized exchange zero-fee futures programs with API · also: https://www.mexc.com/api-docs/futures/account-and-trading-endpoints/place-order
- [statement] Bybit's Aug 10, 2026 announcement says its discount covers 170+ TradFi Perpetual Contract symbols, with availability until further notice, for all TradFi Perpetual Contract symbols (excluding Pre-IPO symbols). The discounted maker rate is 0% against a standard ~0.0200%, and the discounted taker rate is ~0.0275% (varies by VIP level) against ~0.0550%. Bybit's futures fee page has a column labelled TradFi Perps 50% off: a Regular User shows maker 0% and taker 0.0275%, and Supreme VIP also shows a 0% maker rate. TokenPost reports that ANTAUSDT, GLXYUSDT and TMOUSDT were scheduled to start trading on Tuesday, Nov. 17, with a launch promotion that sets fees at zero on limit orders and cuts market-order fees by 50%. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-22) — https://announcements.bybit.com/en/article/trade-tradfi-perpetual-contracts-with-discounted-fees--artb2fe3d16ab53/ · keywords: Centralized exchange zero-fee futures programs with API · also: https://www.bybit.com/en/fee/futures, https://www.tokenpost.com/news/business/59345
- [statement] Bitfinex's POST /v2/auth/r/summary documentation lists a FEE_INFO array ("Array with info on your current fee rates") whose maker part includes DERIV_REBATE ("Shows the maker rebate for derivative trades on the account") and whose taker part includes DERIV_TAKER_FEE ("Shows the taker fee rate for derivative trades on the account"), plus a TRADING_VOL_AND_FEE array ("Array with data on your trading volume and fees paid"). The documented rate limit is 90 req/min, and the page shows "Updatedover 1 year ago". The Bitfinex Q&A also tells users to review trade history to confirm that fees are set to zero. (medium confidence) — https://docs.bitfinex.com/reference/rest-auth-summary · keywords: Centralized exchange zero-fee futures programs with API · also: https://blog.bitfinex.com/products/zero-fees-qa/
- [statement] MEXC's 0-Fee Fest FAQ says eligibility is based on factors such as account status, trading activity, effective trading volume, risk review, and market conditions, and is granted automatically after regular system evaluations. Each pair's 0-fee allocation comes with a validity period, and unused trading volume quota is forfeited when it expires. The system may adjust the 0-fee maximum trading volume periodically, including increasing, reducing, or removing the quota. Once the quota is fully used, trades on that pair revert to the standard fee rate. If an account triggers risk control during the event, the 0-fee benefit is suspended until the restriction is lifted, and zero fees do not apply to liquidation. An unofficial SDK README says the set of 0-fee pairs is curated per account and changes over time. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-22) — https://www.mexc.com/zero-fee · keywords: Centralized exchange zero-fee futures programs with API · also: https://github.com/oboshto/mexc-futures-sdk
- [statement] Bybit's fee schedule page has a column labelled TradFi Perps 50% off, which shows zero maker rates for the Regular User and Supreme VIP rows. An aggregator article from OneBullEx says that during the promotion period limit orders on the stock perpetual contracts will incur zero fees, while market orders will receive a 50% discount on the standard taker fee. The only API-specific line on the schedule is that the MNT fee discount is not available to Pro-tier users or for API orders, liquidation orders, Trading Bot orders, or Copy Trading followers. The help-center fee page lists Perpetual & Expiry Contracts (Crypto and TradFi Perpetuals) with VIP 0 at 0.0550% taker and 0.0200% maker, so the two Bybit pages differ. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-22) — https://www.bybit.com/en/fee/futures · keywords: Centralized exchange zero-fee futures programs with API · also: https://www.onebullex.com/news/articles/bybit-launches-stock-perpetuals-tuesday-with-25x-leverage-and-zero-fee-limit-orders, https://www.bybit.com/en/help-center/article/Trading-Fee-Structure
- [statement] Bitfinex API limits are modest for high-frequency work. The requirements page says the current REST rate limit is between 10 and 90 requests per minute depending on the specific REST API endpoint, and that a rate-limited IP is blocked for 60 seconds. For WebSocket, you cannot open more than 5 (authenticated) connections per 15 seconds, and you can subscribe to up to 25 channels at the same time per connection. The REST Submit Order page lists a rate limit of 90 reqs/min. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-04-17) — https://docs.bitfinex.com/docs/requirements-and-limitations · keywords: Centralized exchange zero-fee futures programs with API · also: https://docs.bitfinex.com/reference/rest-auth-submit-order

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] MEXC's own comparison article gives a cost example: a spot strategy turning over $500,000 a month with an 80% maker share costs $600 in total fees a year on MEXC's standard spot schedule, versus $240 in maker fees plus $80 in taker fees a month, or $3,840 a year, if routed through the MEXC futures API at the June 2026 schedule. The example is a vendor illustration. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-08-03) — https://www.mexc.com/learn/article/crypto-trading-api-comparison-2026-rate-limits-sandboxes-and-the-fees-your-code-actually-pays/1
- [statement] Binance's 2026-11-04 notice says the TradFi Perps promotion announced on 2026-03-31 continues on its original terms, with a Promotion Period of 2026-03-31 02:00 (UTC) until further notice. Regular to VIP 3 users continue to receive a 20% discount on taker fees and VIP 4 to 9 users a 50% discount, compared to the standard USDT taker fee rate. Its table lists 0.0000% maker for Regular User and VIP 1 to VIP 9; taker is 0.0400% (0.0360% with the 10% BNB discount) for Regular User and VIP 1, and 0.0085% (0.0077%) for VIP 9. On 2026-10-28 Binance announced the VIP 4 to 9 discount would be reduced from 50% to 40% with effect from 2026-11-05 08:00 (UTC); the 2026-11-04 notice says that change will not be implemented. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-04) — https://www.binance.com/en/support/announcement/detail/e3424d3a781841eb8b507bc694c0ca3a · keywords: Centralized exchange zero-fee futures programs with API · also: https://www.binance.com/en/support/announcement/detail/4f406308840549ffb8fdaac9873c25a8
- [statement] Binance's 2026-07-02 notice introduces a fee discount promotion for U (United Stables)-margined perpetual contracts, starting with BTCU and ETHU. All regular to VIP 9 users enjoy 0 maker fees during the Promotion Period, which runs from 2026-07-02 10:00 (UTC) until further notice. Regular to VIP 3 users receive a 20% discount on taker fees and VIP 4 to 9 users a 50% discount, compared to the standard USDT taker fee rate; the table lists 0.0400% taker for a regular user, 0.0150% for VIP 4 and 0.0085% for VIP 9. Binance's fee page repeats that all regular and VIP 1 to 9 users get 0 maker fee and up to 50% discounts on taker fees when trading any U (United Stable)- Margined Perps during the Promotion Period. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-07-02) — https://www.binance.com/en/support/announcement/detail/2d6508a405454beb8ebbb9e0f1a695fe · keywords: Centralized exchange zero-fee futures programs with API · also: https://www.binance.com/en/fee/futureFee
- [statement] Bitfinex's announcement of Wednesday, December 17, 2025 says fees for all maker and taker activity on Bitfinex platforms will no longer be charged, effective immediately, with zero fees applying to products including derivatives trading. Its fee schedule lists derivatives trades with maker fees Zero and taker fees Zero. The Zero Fees Q&A says this is not a short term promotion, that there is no fixed end date, and that zero maker and taker fees apply to all trading pairs within the eligible product categories. Forbes says the announcement positions this as a long-term strategy rather than promotional activity, and Coinspeaker (via Yahoo Finance) says the change has no defined date to end. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-22) — https://www.bitfinex.com/post/?id=1163 · keywords: Centralized exchange zero-fee futures programs with API · also: https://blog.bitfinex.com/products/zero-fees-qa/, https://www.bitfinex.com/fees/, https://www.forbes.com/sites/boazsobrado/2025/12/17/bitfinex-goes-free-will-crypto-exchanges-face-a-2019-schwab-moment/, https://finance.yahoo.com/news/bitfinex-slashes-trading-fees-zero-173400203.html
- [statement] Check the fee your API orders actually pay before sizing a strategy on a zero-fee headline. MEXC's own API comparison tells readers to check each venue's API fee schedule before deploying, because it can differ from the fee page; KCEX's blog says a trader who builds a bot using a promotional web fee may discover that the API has a separate schedule; Bitfinex's summary endpoint documents DERIV_TAKER_FEE and DERIV_REBATE; and Binance's change log lists the GET /fapi/v1/commissionRate endpoint to get user commission rate. (high confidence) — https://www.mexc.com/learn/article/crypto-trading-api-comparison-2026-rate-limits-sandboxes-and-the-fees-your-code-actually-pays/1 · keywords: Centralized exchange zero-fee futures programs with API · also: https://blog.kcex.com/kcex-guide/lowest-futures-fees-2026-api-web-funding-basis-cost/, https://docs.bitfinex.com/reference/rest-auth-summary, https://developers.binance.com/en/docs/products/derivatives-trading-usds-futures/change-log

## Facts and statements

- [statement] MEXC's own 0-Fee Fest page states that institutional accounts, market makers, project teams and API users are not eligible for 0 fees. The MEXC 'best zero-fee exchanges' article repeats that MEXC's event terms exclude API users, institutions and market makers from zero-fee promotions. The headline zero-fee futures rate therefore does not describe an API strategy on MEXC. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-08-19) — https://www.mexc.com/zero-fee · keywords: Centralized exchange zero-fee futures programs with API · also: https://www.mexc.com/learn/article/best-zero-fee-crypto-exchanges-2026-we-checked-8-fee-schedules-only-one-is-zero-on-every-line-/1
- [statement] BingX announced zero trading fees on TradFi perpetual futures for eligible users in certain regions starting 2026-11-19 (UTC+8). The announcement says the zero-fee promotion applies exclusively to TradFi Perpetual Futures, and that other futures trading, spot trading, and API trading are excluded. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-17) — https://bingx.com/en/support/articles/18416986883343/
- [statement] MEXC's 0-Fee Fest notices exclude API traders. The notice adding NVDAUSDT, SOXLUSDT, SOXLUSDC and SOXLUSD1 to the 0-Fee Fest says 'Zero fees do not apply to API trading' and that zero fees do not apply to liquidation. The 0-Fee Fest page also says institutional accounts, market makers, project teams, and API users are not eligible for 0 fees. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-17) — https://www.mexc.com/announcements/article/0-fee-fest-17827791539786 · keywords: Centralized exchange zero-fee futures programs with API · also: https://www.mexc.com/zero-fee, https://www.mexc.com/learn/article/best-zero-fee-crypto-exchanges-2026-we-checked-8-fee-schedules-only-one-is-zero-on-every-line-/1
- [statement] MEXC announced it would enable API access for selected BTC and ETH Spot trading pairs starting on Mar 1, 2026, 08:00 (UTC), and its futures API launched on Mar 31, 2026, 06:00 (UTC). Earlier, MEXC announced it would temporarily disable API for all trading pairs for upgrade and maintenance on July 25, 2022 2:30 (UTC), after which users would not be able to place orders for any futures trading pairs through the API. A ccxt commenter wrote on Nov 30, 2023 that under api permissions it says trading under maintenance. A freqtrade commenter wrote on Jan 10, 2025 that big pairs are not available via API for customers. (medium confidence) — https://www.mexc.com/announcements/article/mexc-upgrade-and-maintenance-of-api-for-perpetual-futures-trading-pairs-8681589415961 · keywords: Centralized exchange zero-fee futures programs with API · also: https://github.com/ccxt/ccxt/issues/20175, https://github.com/freqtrade/freqtrade/issues/11214, https://www.mexc.com/announcements/api-updates
- [statement] MEXC will gradually migrate its Futures WebSocket market data feeds from JSON to Protocol Buffers (Protobuf). Clients that still receive Futures market data through WebSocket feeds in JSON format must update and test their API integrations to support Protobuf before the migration deadline of Dec 1, 2026, 10:00 (UTC). MEXC's API Updates feed also says MEXC would officially enable a new access domain for Futures APIs on Jan 12, 2026, 10:00 (UTC). (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-12) — https://www.mexc.com/announcements/article/mexc-to-migrate-futures-websocket-market-data-from-json-to-protobuf-17827791539697 · keywords: Centralized exchange zero-fee futures programs with API · also: https://www.mexc.com/announcements/api-updates
- [statement] MEXC's futures API guide says its Open-API directly supports three request sources: APP, WEB, and OPEN-API. For WEB or APP requests the Authorization header carries the corresponding token value, while OPEN-API requests use ApiKey, Request-Time, Signature and optional Recv-Window headers. Public repos use the browser WEB-token route: hostnes/MexcApiBypass requires a 'WEB' format access token obtained from a browser session; vecful/mexc-futures-api sells a Futures API SDK for $120 and advertises trading even during official API maintenance; oboshto/mexc-futures-sdk warns that it uses browser session tokens and reverse-engineered endpoints and that MEXC does not officially support futures trading through API. MEXC's launch notice reserves the right to suspend or revoke API access in cases of abuse. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-22) — https://www.mexc.com/api-docs/futures/integration-guide · keywords: Centralized exchange zero-fee futures programs with API · also: https://github.com/hostnes/MexcApiBypass, https://github.com/vecful/mexc-futures-api, https://github.com/oboshto/mexc-futures-sdk, https://www.mexc.com/announcements/article/introducing-api-futures-trading-on-mar-31-2026-17827791534551
- [statement] BingX has run several TradFi zero-fee windows. A pilot ran from 2026-02-11 12:00 (UTC+8) to 2026-03-13 12:00 (UTC+8) in select regions; its rules say accounts that have created an API Key are not eligible for the zero-fee policy (regardless of whether API trading is used) and that users should delete the API Key first to participate. A BingX blog describes a zero-fee campaign for BingX TradFi Futures running from April 13 to July 31, with partners and affiliates continuing to receive full commissions through platform-funded subsidies. The promotion starting 2026-11-19 (UTC+8) gives zero trading fees on TradFi perpetual futures to eligible users in certain regions, applies exclusively to TradFi Perpetual Futures with other futures trading, spot trading, and API trading excluded, and has an end date to be announced separately. BingX reserves the right to revoke eligibility and recover related fee reductions if wash trading, arbitrage, or other violations are detected. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-17) — https://bingx.com/en/support/articles/18416986883343/ · keywords: Centralized exchange zero-fee futures programs with API · also: https://bingx.com/en/support/articles/15133027205263, https://bingx.com/en/blog/article/bingx-launches-zero-fee-tradfi-futures-maintains-full-partner-commissions
- [statement] Per Deribit's insights post, its fee schedule changed effective from the 1st of August 2026. Deribit's fee page lists Standard perpetuals and futures fees of 1.5 / 3.5 bps (maker/taker) with no criteria; VIP1 at 0 / 3 bps with criteria of $100k USDC equity, or $250k total equity; and VIP4 to VIP7 at -0.2 / 1.75, -0.3 / 1.5, -0.4 / 1.4 and -0.4 / 1.4 (negative maker fees represent maker rebates). A later post says new, lower taker fees for VIP4 through VIP7 take effect on 19 October 2026: 1.75, 1.50, 1.40 and 1.40 bps. Deribit's fee page lists API usage among the additional things it does not charge fees for. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-22) — https://support.deribit.com/hc/en-us/articles/25944746248989-Fees · keywords: Centralized exchange zero-fee futures programs with API · also: https://insights.deribit.com/exchange-updates/new-fee-schedule-on-deribit/, https://insights.deribit.com/exchange-updates/new-fee-tier-on-perpetuals-and-futures/
- [statement] Confirm the fee a given API key pays from account data, not from the banner. Deribit's fee page says you can view your fee discount level using private/get_account_summary or private/get_account_summaries methods (with the extended:true parameter). Bitfinex's Q&A says to review trade history or check the Fee Schedule to confirm that maker and taker fees for the relevant products are set to zero. The oboshto MEXC SDK README says getOrderHistory returns the takerFeeRate / makerFeeRate actually applied to each filled order. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-11-22) — https://support.deribit.com/hc/en-us/articles/25944746248989-Fees · keywords: Centralized exchange zero-fee futures programs with API · also: https://blog.bitfinex.com/products/zero-fees-qa/, https://github.com/oboshto/mexc-futures-sdk
